CONFIG.title: Family 10 affine/linearized-model control: exact normal-equation covariance vs K_IS^-1 / K_eff^-1

noise.per_trial_data: y_i = y0 + noise_i  (fixed true pose dx=0)
noise.free_fit: min_{c,dx} ||[A B][c;dx] - y_i||^2 + alpha||dx||^2 via np.linalg.lstsq on augmented rows [A B; 0 sqrt(alpha)I]
noise.empirical_covariance: unbiased sample covariance of map errors c_hat - c0 over trials

theory.P_free: K_eff^-1, K_eff = A^T W A, W = I - B(B^T B + alpha I)^-1 B^T
theory.P_samp: exact repeated-sampling map covariance for the fixed-true-pose protocol = top-left block of H^-1 H_data H^-1
theory.note: P_free is realized by the prior-consistent protocol that draws dx_i ~ N(0, alpha^-1 I) per trial; P_samp is the covariance of the same estimator when only y noise is drawn (as requested).

family10_source_config.pose_theta_convention: theta = atan2(-p_y, -p_x): body +x axis points toward the origin

noise_model.whitening: scalar division of complex blocks and forward by 1/sigma_f
noise_model.realification: A_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(A_w); Im(A_w)], B_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(B_w); Im(B_w)] via hh.whiten_realify(A_w, B_w, None); y_R = sqrt(2)*[Re(F_w); Im(F_w)]
noise_model.stacked_noise_covariance: I_m_real after realification (independent standard Gaussians on each stacked row)
noise_model.noise_draw: one default_rng(20260903); the same per-trial draw is applied to both Born and full-wave true data (matched comparison)

fit.note: local fits started at true parameters; x_scale='jac' preconditions the trust region on top of a Fisher-whitened coordinate system (theta = theta0 + T y with T^T H_true T = I for known-pose H=K_IS and free-pose H=joint information), which only changes optimizer conditioning, not the NLS optimum. 'success' rows are those with status True.

finite_difference_self_check.note: one centered finite-difference check of the realified stacked residual Jacobian at the true point (locally duplicated code only for Born B, whose API is absent from the reused modules)

finite_difference_self_check_full_wave.note: centered finite-difference checks of the realified full-wave stacked residual Jacobian at (c0, dx=0): full-c and full-dx unit directions plus one joint random direction.  The analytic data rows [-A_stack, -B_stack] and prior rows [0, sqrt(alpha) I] are compared against (r(theta+eps w)-r(theta-eps w))/(2 eps).

family10_source_config.coefficient_choice: c0 = argmin_c ||S c - chi0||_2 (numpy lstsq); chi_true = S c0
family10_source_config.scope_note: finite-dimensional toy only; no continuum, global-nonlinearity, real-SLAM-system, or production claim

fixed_true_pose_affine_mc.protocol: fixed true pose: y_i = y0 + noise_i; free fit penalizes dx about 0

prior_consistent_affine_mc_diagnostic.protocol: prior-consistent: dx_i ~ N(0, alpha^-1 I) drawn per trial; y_i = y0 + B dx_i + noise_i; free fit penalizes dx about 0
